Dynamic Creatures shows Hugo, a character robot with 43 actuators

The new video illustrates its hospitality ambitions; unsupervised guest interaction remains unproven.

Humanoids Daily ↗12 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2Videos 1

A mobile guest-facing character

Dynamic Creatures released a Hugo video on October 12, showing a purple furry robot raising a hand and moving through an office. The company describes 43 actuators combined with character design and expressive movement for entertainment and hospitality.

Expression remains in development

Its Vision-Language-Expression model is being developed to connect perception and language with gestures, movement and emotional expression. Navigation and close-contact safety are also described as work in progress, not fully established capabilities.

Autonomy and hardware are unconfirmed

A development-screen image resembles a modified Unitree G1, but the company has not confirmed that identification. Its earlier Boston Dynamics partnership does not identify Hugo’s hardware either. The clip provides no intervention rate or sustained guest-operation results.
